title: Gulf of Georgia Cannery National Historic Site

services.name: Admissions
services.desc: Please note re: Gulf of Georgia Cannery NHS fee increase. Updated admission fees are in effect as of January 1, 2024. More Info. **All Parks Canada national parks and historic sites, including the Gulf of Georgia Cannery NHS, offer free general admission for youth 17 years old and under, with appropriate adult supervision (minimum 1:6 ratio for organized groups of 10+). Free youth admission does not apply to bookings for enhanced services including heritage presentation programs such as tour groups, school programs, and facilitated site explorations.
